text:
The change moves noc2 from VLAN 99 (noc group, 10.99.0.0/24) to VLAN 98 (noc-lab, 10.98.0.0/24), with new IP 10.98.0.21. The ticket is vague ("as discussed"), but the diff shows a move into the noc-lab segment. The intended outcome is that noc2 now has the same access as the noc-lab reference host noclab1. Tests also verify that its old noc access is gone and that unrelated traffic is unaffected.
